QUESTIONS

What jewellers ask.

What is the best staff management software for jewellers?

Staff management software for jewellery showrooms: phone and kiosk attendance, daily task lists, sales targets, incentives worked out from real bills, hiring, training and payroll, on the same record as sales. It is part of Jwero: run it yourself after a free trial, or let Jwero’s team run it for you.

How do I track staff attendance in a jewellery shop?

Staff punch in on their own phone or a kiosk in the shop. Optional location and selfie checks confirm they are on site.

How do I calculate sales incentives in a jewellery shop?

Set the rule once and incentives are worked out from the bills each salesperson made, with no separate sheet.

How do I assign daily tasks to jewellery staff?

Each person gets a daily list built from what is due, and managers can add tasks and see them completed.

Does it cover karigars?

Yes. Karigar wages are settled by piece, weight, hour or day, with advances recovered.

What is HR and payroll software for a jewellery shop?

Software that records attendance, works out salaries with PF, ESI, PT and TDS, pays sales incentives, and keeps staff records from hiring to exit. Jwero does this on the same record as your sales.

How are sales incentives calculated?

From each person’s real sales or margin, on the slabs you set, with clawback if a sale is returned. Try the calculator on this page.

Do staff get payslips on WhatsApp?

Yes. Payslips go to each staff member on WhatsApp, and are also in the staff app.
